register: published record specifications and supplied recording observations
verification_policy: Published specifications retain their per-entry retrieval dates; this update does not claim they were refetched. Marketing record claims remain distinct from independent measurement. Supplied-recording metrics are computed from the original local files, with RFDB identity and processing checks documented separately. Unknown calibration, seat and timing information is not invented. A single observation is useful engineering evidence but does not establish a population median, recording spread or calibrated uncertainty. No peak substitutes for ten-second exposure.

rfdb.access: rideInfo metadata public; /getRec traces gated to logged-in users per About privacy policy. This repo performs no bypass.

supplied_recordings.status: three usable engineering observations; one per ride; strict multi-record qualification not established
supplied_recordings.method: Nominal 50 Hz sample indices; source calibration-row projection; vertical=RFDB y, lateral=-RFDB x, longitudinal=RFDB z; gravity retained; exact piecewise-linear positive ten-second integral. Display metrics use the full-sequence centered 11-sample mean before cropping. No basis repair, time warping or calibrated uncertainty claim.
supplied_recordings.identity_check: Each local file date plus startIndex/50 matches the named public RFDB recording date; reconstructed display vertical extrema match stored source extrema within 1e-10 g.
supplied_recordings.recording_spread: unavailable: one supplied independent recording per ride
supplied_recordings.measurement_uncertainty: not quantified; filtering sensitivity is reported separately and does not bound device calibration or timebase error

limits.i305_benchmark: Pantherian 6839 raw data and computed S10 are available above. A +10 percent comparison to this single observation is 33.021544 g*s raw or 32.928185 g*s displayed, not a qualified population median. Seat, device stability and calibrated uncertainty remain unverified; between-recording spread is unavailable. Historical processed/benchmark.json remains unchanged.
limits.peaks_vs_exposure: RFDB browse peaks alone cannot determine S10; the supplied full traces can. Supplied recording count is one each for Falcon's Flight, Pantherian and Tormenta. Publicly listed recording counts are not downloaded independent observations. Do-Dodonpa remains archival context.
limits.aggregation_policy: Current tools require the same ride/configuration/seat/device/calibration_id and at least three independent recordings. This is an implemented restriction, not a general scientific requirement. An explicitly reviewed compatible population may include different validated devices and per-run calibrations, with seat/device metadata retained as strata; no such policy change or eligibility promotion is applied by this register.
limits.wikipedia: Wikipedia summaries are leads, never verified specs.
limits.game_vs_record: 220 m / 270 km/h (75 m/s) / 1.4 s (0-50 m/s) / 80 m inversion are configured game goals, not confirmed world records.
